description: Maximum number of operations in flight at once. Protects pools, partner APIs and memory from unbounded fan-out.
N async loops pulling items from a shared cursor; a freed slot immediately takes the next item.
Running fixed groups with `Promise.all`. Respects the limit but each group waits for its slowest item.
Reject on the first error and start no new work. The alternative is collecting every outcome like `allSettled`.
Concurrency caps simultaneous operations; a rate limit caps operations per time window. Short tasks can exceed a rate limit at low concurrency.
Popular npm helpers: `pLimit(n)` wraps calls, `pMap(items, fn, { concurrency })` maps a list.
